with observed as (
 select model_run_id,sale_type_id,target_stage_id,target_stage_label,funnel_position,opportunity_key,
 first_reached_observed_at,previous_stage_first_reached_at,transition_reached_at
 from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_funnel_progress`
 where (NULL is null or sale_type_id=NULL)
 and (NULL is null or team_key=NULL)
)
select model_run_id,sale_type_id,target_stage_id,target_stage_label,funnel_position,
 uniqExactIf(opportunity_key,first_reached_observed_at<parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z',3,'UTC')) as nb_reached,
 countIf(previous_stage_first_reached_at<parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z',3,'UTC')) as nb_transition_base,
 countIf(transition_reached_at<parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z',3,'UTC'))/nullIf(nb_transition_base,0) as transition_rate
from observed group by model_run_id,sale_type_id,target_stage_id,target_stage_label,funnel_position

-- One metric and month per group; incomplete segments remain unknown.
select model_run_id,month_date,metric_code,sum(target_value) as sum_target,
 if(countIf(actual_value is null)=0,sum(actual_value),NULL) as sum_actual,
 sum_actual/nullIf(sum_target,0) as attainment_rate
from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_sales_objectives_month`
group by model_run_id,month_date,metric_code

select model_run_id,tenant_id,opportunity_id,object_kind,object_key,started_at,ended_at,stage_label,event_type,
from_stage_id,to_stage_id,time_basis,is_left_censored,employee_display_name,team_name,slice_duration_days
from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_opportunity_timeline`
where opportunity_id=0
order by started_at,object_kind,object_key

with eligible as (
 select model_run_id,opportunity_key,company_key,team_key,is_open,is_demo_stage,sale_type_id,pipeline_amount,weighted_pipeline_amount,is_amount_calculable
 from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_pipeline_periods`
 where valid_from_at<parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z',3,'UTC')
 and (valid_to_at is null or valid_to_at>=parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z',3,'UTC'))
 and (NULL is null or team_key=NULL)
)
select model_run_id,countIf(is_open and sale_type_id in (4,7)) as nb_open_opportunities,
 uniqExactIf(company_key,is_open and is_demo_stage and company_key is not null and sale_type_id in (4,7)) as nb_in_demo_companies,
 if(countIf(not is_amount_calculable)=0,sumIf(pipeline_amount,is_open),NULL) as sum_open_amount
from eligible group by model_run_id

-- A single closing stock; team filters do not apply to portfolio measures.
-- Whole-population evidence is required: unresolved-company lines cannot disappear in a global sum.
with coverage as (
 select model_run_id,
 countIf(measure_id='revenue.active_mrr' and availability_status='available')=1 as active_mrr_available,
 countIf(measure_id='revenue.new_mrr' and availability_status='available')=1 as new_mrr_available,
 countIf(measure_id='revenue.churn_mrr' and availability_status='available')=1 as churn_mrr_available,
 countIf(measure_id='revenue.active_clients' and availability_status='available')=1 as active_clients_available,
 max(coverage_status) as revenue_coverage_status
 from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_publication_status` where dataset_family='company_mrr_month'
 group by model_run_id
)
select d.model_run_id,d.closing_date,
 if(any(q.active_mrr_available) and countIf(sum_mrr_end is null)=0,sum(sum_mrr_end),NULL) as sum_active_mrr,
 if(any(q.new_mrr_available) and countIf(sum_new_mrr is null)=0,sum(sum_new_mrr),NULL) as sum_new_mrr,
 if(any(q.churn_mrr_available) and countIf(sum_churn_mrr is null)=0,sum(sum_churn_mrr),NULL) as sum_churn_mrr,
 if(any(q.active_clients_available) and countIf(is_active_end is null)=0,countIf(is_active_end),NULL) as nb_active_clients,
 if(any(q.active_clients_available) and countIf(is_active_begin is null)=0,countIf(is_departure)/nullIf(countIf(is_active_begin),0),NULL) as client_churn_rate,
 any(q.revenue_coverage_status) as revenue_coverage_status
from `dtr_sales`.`dataset_company_mrr_month` d inner join coverage q on d.model_run_id=q.model_run_id
group by d.model_run_id,d.closing_date
